description: Unified mnemonic derivation conformance vectors for packages/shared/src/derive.ts. valid[] mnemonics are standard BIP-39 reference test vectors (Trezor/python-mnemonic vectors.json) — chosen because they're independently-known-valid, not app-specific secrets. Each entry pins deriveP256Scalar(mnemonic, HKDF_INFO_ROOT) -> publicKeyFromPrivate -> didKeyFromPublicKey against `did`, deriveSecp256k1Scalar(mnemonic, HKDF_INFO_NOSTR) -> schnorr.getPublicKey (BIP-340 x-only, hex) against `nostrPubkeyHex`, and deriveBackupKeyFromMnemonic(mnemonic) (HKDF_INFO_BACKUP, 32-byte AES key, NO curve reduction) against `backupKeyHex` — the Portable Backup Key for cross-device SOLB v2 Backup Archives (docs/adr/0001). These `did`/`nostrPubkeyHex` values are self-consistency fixtures generated by this package's own derive.ts (not independently cross-checked against a second implementation) — they exist so a future regression in the derivation rule (HKDF salt/info, scalar-reduction constants, curve order) fails loudly, and so the web viewer's W1 milestone can replay the exact same mnemonics and assert the exact same outputs for App<->Web identity portability (04-plan Phase A1 amendment). invalid[] mnemonics must make deriveP256Scalar/deriveSecp256k1Scalar throw RangeError containing `errorContains`. Consumed by packages/shared/test/derive.test.ts.

valid.name: bip39-reference-vector-legal-winner-thank
valid.source: BIP-39 official test vector (Trezor python-mnemonic vectors.json, entropy 0x7f7f...7f7f)
valid.mnemonic: legal winner thank year wave sausage worth useful legal winner thank yellow

valid.name: bip39-reference-vector-zoo-wrong
valid.source: BIP-39 official test vector (Trezor python-mnemonic vectors.json, entropy 0xffff...ffff)
valid.mnemonic: zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo zoo wrong

invalid.name: broken-checksum-all-abandon
invalid.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon
invalid.reason: 12x 'abandon' has the wrong checksum word — the valid all-zero-entropy vector ends with 'about', not 'abandon'; every word is in the wordlist so this specifically exercises the checksum check, not word validation

invalid.name: non-bip39-sentence
invalid.mnemonic: not a real mnemonic at all just some words
invalid.reason: 12 words but not all in the BIP-39 English wordlist and not a valid checksum sentence
